source.boundary: TBESH source-node identity and abridged sense boundaries are evidence only; OpenScriptures full BDB remains primary and must be cross-checked before candidate generation.

targets.boundary: God/gods grammatical and referential distinction; avoid deriving theology from grammatical number alone
divine proper-name identity vs reading/translation tradition must remain separate
individual father, ancestor, head/founder, originator and figurative senses; do not import divine fatherhood where context does not require it
child/son, descendant/people, young animal, type/member, heir, warrior and age constructions require context separation
be/exist, become, happen/come to pass, remain/situated/accompany and Niphal event/result senses; clause-level context required
man/male, husband, person/human, servant, mankind, champion/great man, anyone/each
woman vs wife/widow vs female/another constructions; token context required
say/speak/answer, inner speech/think, command/promise/intend and passive/called senses must track stem and syntax
make/do/perform/produce vs offering/institution/bring-about and separate press/squeeze homograph; morphology required
see/perceive/consider, appear/be seen, show, select/provide and idiomatic extensions require stem/context control
